snippet.title: I gave an AI agent access to my site's code #Shorts
snippet.description:
Every week it reads my real analytics, finds the one thing quietly costing me signups, and writes the fix as a real pull request — not a to-do list.

Then it messages me on Telegram. I reply YES and it ships. I reply nothing and nothing happens. It watches the numbers for 48h afterwards, and if a fix ever makes things worse it proposes the rollback itself.

No dashboard full of suggestions you still have to build yourself. One conversion fix, every week, shipped with your YES.

Works on a GitHub repo or a Shopify store.
14-day free trial, no card → https://velyr.io
